Immutable upstream source snapshot for IAMCCS R38B.
Only specific modules are loaded in a private namespace when R38B executes.
Neither package __init__.py is executed: no global tokenizer/guide patches,
node registration, web routes or extra dependencies are installed.
The RTX frame adapter uses IAMCCS's existing NVIDIA runtime and RGB layout.
